card.name: Words just before stopping or weaning treatment
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "be", "or" that come right before a verb about stopping, weaning or discontinuing a drug. Also fires on "Dis" in "Discontinuation".

modes.label: Linking word before stop/wean
modes.description: "to", "be" or "or" sits just before a word like weaned, reduce or discontinued.
modes.example: is ready<< to>> be weaned from GENOSYL therapy

modes.label: Inside discontinuation
modes.description: The start of the word discontinuation in a weaning heading.
modes.example: Weaning and<< Dis>>continuation Avoid abrupt discontinuation of GEN

modes.label: Stray non-drug case
modes.description: A noun in a wildlife-agency sentence where a status change follows.
modes.example: US Fish and Wildlife<< Service>> downgraded their status in Florida to threatened
